# Signed OOXML test fixtures

The three `hello-world-signed` fixtures are unmodified samples from the Apache POI `test-data/xmldsign` directory at revision `c94ee8ad9096bdb8cf8e5e59d8d12432e950dbf3`. They are used to exercise read-only editing and byte-for-byte original downloads. [Source fixtures](https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/c94ee8ad9096bdb8cf8e5e59d8d12432e950dbf3/test-data/xmldsign)
